verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer Autofix generating suggested code fixes for errors. Its coding-agent integration sends Seer's root-cause analysis to an agent "for automated fix generation and pull request creation," for example by launching Cursor Cloud Agents from Seer to create PRs. Seer requires a paid subscription. missing for 10: evidence that Seer itself opens the PR natively without a third-party coding agent, detail on the PR review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
